sn46.25:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you seven things that lead to nondecline.
sn46.25:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, are the seven things that lead to nondecline?
sn46.25:1.7: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.25:1.8: These are the seven things that lead to nondecline.”
